data.name: Table Habit
data.subtitle: Open-source micro-habit tracker with WebDAV sync
data.localizedDescription: Table Habit is a free, open-source habit tracker for building micro habits: a scoring system grades consistency rather than raw streaks, growth charts show the trend, and everything syncs across devices through any WebDAV endpoint - Nextcloud, Koofr or a self-hosted one. Offline-first, no ads, no in-app purchases and no account required, licensed under Apache-2.0. The iOS build OmniSource tracks is the project's own unsigned IPA from its GitHub releases, which AltStore, SideStore, Feather and ESign sign with your certificate at install time.
data.versionDescription:
Table Habit 1.27.15 | mhabit-unsigned

# Released: v1.27.15+204

## ✨ Features

- Integrate native desktop title bars and keep app bars pinned while scrolling
  (#677)
  - Fuse macOS window controls with adaptive toolbars and handle fullscreen
    transitions
  - Match native title bar colors to the app theme on Windows and Linux
- Keep a manually collapsed sidebar closed across layout and interface-style
  changes within the current session (#679)
- Restore desktop window size and position before the window first appears
  (#681)
  - Save ordinary window geometry without treating fullscreen or maximized
    bounds as the preferred window size

## 🐛 Fixes

- Preserve open dialogs and their state while updating theme colors, and keep
  dialog app bars consistent with their local theme (#677)
- Restore the Settings Back button when the sidebar and its collapsed toolbar
  navigation are hidden (#678)

## 🧹 Others

- Add desktop native regression tests and integrate them into local and CI
  test workflows (#677)

[Full Changelog](https://github.com/FriesI23/mhabit/compare/v1.27.13+202...v1.27.15+204)

compatibility.notes: The release ships one unsigned iOS IPA next to Android APKs, flatpaks, a dmg and an msix; only mhabit-unsigned.ipa is distributed here, so the app must be re-signed by a client and cannot run as downloaded.
